system.description:
Requirements: Training (1) and Expertise (1) in Arcana

You have learned to unmake spells after they have been cast.

As an Action, you can attempt to remove the magical effect of a spell within 30 spaces.

This requires a successful Counteract check using Mind (Arcana).

If you succeed, the spell is removed and no longer has any effect. If you fail, the spell continues as normal.

If you fail and try to dispel the spell again, the Complexity of the Counteract check increases by +1.

customTrait.name: Counteract
customTrait.description: This ability is specifically for countering spells.
